jobs.occupation: Product Portfolio Manager, focus High Power Electrical Drives (m/f/d) (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Innomotics GmbH
JobID: 6858
Location: Erlangen, Schuhstr. 60
Department: IN SYSO PPM
Mode of Employment:  Permanent / Full-time

We are looking for a Product Portfolio Manager, focus High Power Electrical Drives (m/f/d) to join our team at Innomotics.

The Industry-Leader of Motors and Drives
Innomotics is an industry-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world's most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the #EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.

Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People
We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best-in-class, we want you IN.

As a Product Portfolio Manager, you understand well the high-power drives technology and are responsible for the strategic composition, management, and optimization of the responded portfolios. The primary task is to agree and profitably invest the allocated budgets for innovation (R&D, maintenance) while strictly adhering to stakeholder's portfolio necessities to achieve the business goals set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).

Your Future Role

- Investment Strategy: Define short-term (1 year) and mid-term (3 to 5 years) high-power drives portfolio investment plans to achieve the business goals set in the AOP.
- Innovation: Manage the yearly R&D activities (including maintenance, design to cost, engineering optimization) according to the portfolio investment plan.
- Budget: Agree and manage the yearly R&D budget across the responded high-power drives portfolio (e.g., STATCOM, grid to grid, ship to shore applications).
- Market Analysis: Continuously monitor the relevant global markets and economic trends like energy transition, turbine replacement, power grid opimization.
- Portfolio Rebalancing: Regularly adjust and reallocate innovation investments in response to relevant market changes.
- Portfolio and Business Relations: Provide transparent R&D performance reporting and generate new high-power drives portfolio investment ideas to achieve the business goals set in the AOP.

Your Profile

- You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Electronics or a combination of an electrical engineering technical bachelor's degree and a business-focused master's degree (such as an MBA).
- You are familiar with high-power drives technology (medium voltage drives/systems, high voltage motors) and can represent it internally and externally.
- You have already several years of professional experience with a technology provider, system integrator or consultancy company for high-power power electrical solutions or system design/engineering specialized in projects for energy transition, grid compliance, oil&gas or similar.
- You quickly grasp macroeconomic relationships, build arguments and create a strategic plan.
- You clearly and simply explain complex systems to stakeholders, fluently in English and German.

What's IN it for you (Our Benefits)

- Compensation according to the applicable collective agreements of the metal and electrical industry
- 30 days of vacation per calendar year
- Flexible working models
- Pension benefits
- Development opportunities
- Health care offerings
- Childcare subsidy
- Employer subsidy for "Deutschlandticket"
- Canteens with lower prices for employees
- Access to a benefits portal with attractive employee offers

Ready to power the future with us? Join Innomotics and start making a difference now. #TeamInnomotics #JoinReliableMotion

Innomotics is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

Freudenberg Aftermarket (FAM) is a newly established Business Group bringing together aftermarket activities from across the Freudenberg Group into one focused global organization.
We are looking for a Transfer Pricing Manager to help establish and manage the transfer pricing framework for a growing international business. In this role, you will work at the intersection of tax, finance, business strategy, and international operations, ensuring compliance while supporting sustainable growth across multiple countries and legal entities.

Manager Transfer Pricing (f/m/d)

Responsibilities

- Shape the Transfer Pricing Framework: Design, implement, and continuously develop transfer pricing policies, methodologies, and documentation across the Business Group.
- Manage Tax Risk: Assess transfer pricing implications of business activities and transactions, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.
- Drive Documentation & Compliance: Ensure accurate transfer pricing documentation, tax reporting, and intercompany agreements in line with local and international requirements.
- Support Audits & Regulatory Requirements: Partner with local entities and external auditors to prepare documentation, address inquiries, and support transfer pricing audits.
- Coordinate Global Transfer Pricing Activities: Manage annual intercompany price updates and ensure consistent application of transfer pricing principles across the organization.
- Partner Across the Business: Collaborate with Finance, Tax, and business stakeholders while providing guidance on transfer pricing policies, processes, and requirements.
- Drive Continuous Improvement: Monitor regulatory developments, enhance processes and tools, and support the ongoing digitalization and standardization of transfer pricing activities.

Qualifications

- University degree in Tax, Law, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field; a professional tax qualification is an advantage.
- Several years of experience in Transfer Pricing, International Tax, Corporate Tax, or a related area within an international corporate environment or advisory firm.
- Strong knowledge of OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, international tax regulations, intercompany pricing methodologies, and transfer pricing documentation requirements.
- Proven ability to translate complex tax regulations into practical business solutions while balancing compliance and business needs.
- Experience supporting tax audits, transfer pricing documentation, intercompany agreements, and risk assessments.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across functions and international teams.
- Experience driving process improvements, standardization initiatives, or tax-related projects in a multinational environment.
- Familiarity with transfer pricing tools, ERP systems, and financial data environments; experience with globalDoc and SAP is an advantage.
- Fluent English; additional languages are a plus.

Some of your Benefits

International Opportunities : Grow in your career through international exchange and global job opportunities.
Personal Development : We offer a variety of trainings to ensure you can develop in your career.
Flexible Work Models : We allow for flexible work models to ensure both professional and personal success.
Sustainability & Social Commitment : We support social and sustainable projects and encourage employee involvement.
Diversity & Inclusion : We focus on providing an inclusive environment and recognize our diversity contributes to our success.
